title: Spring start-up and repairs in Rockland

seo.title: Sample project: Rockland irrigation start-up
seo.description: Sample case study: spring start-up for a Rockland garden in Victoria, with frost-cracked lines repaired and the controller set for CRD rules.

summary: Start-up of a heritage garden's system after a cold snap cracked lines.
challenge: A Rockland heritage garden's irrigation system had not been drained before a cold snap, and the owners needed it running before the CRD watering season.
approach: We charged the system zone by zone, found two cracked lateral lines and repaired them.
Heads were turned off the heritage stonework, and the controller was set to the lawn days for the address before Stage 1 began on May 1.
result: System running before the watering season, with a reminder booked for fall shutdown.
links: Read more about [irrigation](/services/irrigation/), see our work in [Victoria](/areas/victoria/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
story: The system had not been drained before a cold snap.
We found and repaired two cracked lines, adjusted heads off the heritage stonework and set the controller before May 1.
